headTurn.description: Turn head: negative image-left, positive image-right.

headNod.description: Head pitch: negative down, positive up.

headTilt.description: Head side tilt: negative counterclockwise, positive clockwise.

torsoTurn.description: Turn torso independently of head: negative image-left, positive image-right.

torsoLean.description: Upper-body side lean: negative counterclockwise, positive clockwise.

torsoRise.description: Upper body: negative settle, positive rise, independent of head pitch.

torsoPitch.description: Upper body: negative lean back, positive lean forward, independent of head.

gazeHorizontal.description: Look image-left (-) or image-right (+), independently of head.

leftArmRaise.description: Image-left arm: positive opens away from body, negative tucks in.

rightArmRaise.description: Image-right arm: positive opens away from body, negative tucks in.

leftArmSwing.description: Swing image-left arm toward image-left (-) or right (+).

rightArmSwing.description: Swing image-right arm toward image-left (-) or right (+).

eyeOpenLeft.description: Image-left eye: closed 0, normally open 1; use alone for a wink.

eyeWide.description: Widen eyes in surprise or interest.

browTiltLeft.description: Image-left eyebrow slant, independently of the other brow.

browTiltRight.description: Image-right eyebrow slant, independently of the other brow.

mouthSmile.description: Frown (-) or smile (+); can colour ongoing speech.

mouthOpen.description: Open mouth while not vocalizing; speech retains articulation ownership.

mouthWide.description: Wide resting mouth shape; only while not vocalizing.

mouthRound.description: Rounded resting mouth shape; only while not vocalizing.

mouthNarrow.description: Narrow resting mouth shape; only while not vocalizing.

mouthSeal.description: Sealed lips; only while not vocalizing.

angry.description: Sustained angry expression, not an automatic response to disagreement.

maniac.description: Full laughing expression; unavailable while speaking or singing.

cry.description: Sustained tearful eyes; speech keeps the mouth.

hairSway.description: Secondary hair response from still (0) to energetic (1); never move hair off its attachment.

chestSway.description: Secondary chest response from still (0) to energetic (1); local asset physics remain bounded.
